cross_verification.note_en: Confirmed directly from the official Government of St. Vincent and the Grenadines (gov.vc) Form A adult passport application PDF, Note 3 ('PHOTOGRAPHS'). It also requires 'Two copies of a recent photograph' and that the certifying officer endorse the reverse of one copy — no background color, expression, or glasses rule is stated on the form itself. The gov.vc TLS certificate does not cover the bare 'gov.vc' hostname (only subdomains like www.gov.vc), which blocks some automated fetchers; content was retrieved successfully via www.gov.vc.
